title: Deep Core Prospecting from the Grand Exchange (Haven): 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter, deep core mining XP; 20 platinum ore mined at Bunda Belt (3 jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:13 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6; rules F34, F37). Foreman Voss offers Deep Core Prospecting on the board of Grand Exchange Station and on six more Nebula boards (table missions, 23:09 UTC); once per pilot (our older copies). Bunda Belt (Nebula space, 3 jumps by Market Prime and Gold Run) reads 1,946 platinum of 8,000, richness 12, beside carbon 1,589 and tungsten 1,067 (census 5.9 h old); min_left 300 keeps the floor our gather there keeps. For the Nebula-born miners' rows only. A test of three results (F37): max_ships 3, the three pilots share the field but draw 60 of 1,646 above the floor. The first stop stores the starter cargo. 2026-11-22 23:21 UTC (Zero): its first runs (23:15 to 23:19 UTC, 2 at Sol Central, 16 at the Grand Exchange) read `deep_core_prospecting not offered` to newborn pilots of Mining 0 (table runs); our Voidborn pilots that took it held Mining near 10. The board's own gate is not read: requires.skills mining 3 is a guess that closes it to the newborns until they have mined, to be read again on the first pilot that reaches it. 2026-11-23 00:40 UTC (Zero): skip_if_booked also names five Voidborn starter rewards (Network Expansion, Signal Fragments, The Collective Provides, The Signal Protocol, First Steps in the Void), which 230 of 246 listed Voidborn pilots hold booked and no newborn does (data/fleet/onetime.json): the five-minute pass puts a mission that pays once into every plan's list First (00:26 and 00:36 UTC), and two Voidborn miners were sent about 10 jumps to Sol for a starter mission they do not hold. A stopgap until a route can name its empires (requests.log ENT-387). 2026-11-23 03:06 UTC (Zero): requires.empire nebula; requires.skills mining 3 -> 5, as on mission-deep-core-prospecting-sol (a Mining 3 pilot refused at Sol Central, 02:45 to 02:48 UTC); a guess, the board's gate not read.
